Description: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 module with 16MB Flash and 8MB PSRAM for display buffer and general processing.

Name: GPS Module
Description: GPS module for outdoor navigation and position sensing.

Name: MPPT Solar Charge Controller
Description: Manages power from the generator to efficiently charge the battery, optimized for maximum power point tracking.

Description: Rechargeable Li-ion battery for portable power.

Description: Indicates system running status.

Description: 5.5x2.1mm DC power female jack with fixed mounting, anti-reverse polarity design.

Name: Enclosure Front Panel
Description: Front panel of the enclosure with cutouts for display, LEDs, and sensor openings.

Description: Heavy-duty sliding mounting plate for securely attaching the SCHEB unit to a wall.

Description: M4 security screw to lock the SCHEB unit onto the wall mounting plate, preventing theft.

Name: Top Ventilation Grille
Description: Weather-resistant louvered ventilation grille for the top section of the enclosure.

Description: Weather-resistant louvered ventilation grille for the bottom section of the enclosure, above sensors.

Description: Fine mesh filter to prevent dust and insects from entering the top ventilation port.

Description: Fine mesh filter to prevent dust and insects from entering the bottom ventilation port.

Name: Carry Handle
Description: Durable carry handle for portability, integrated into the top of the enclosure.

Name: DC Input Cable Gland
Description: Waterproof M16 cable gland for securing the solar panel DC input cable.

Name: Internal Backplate/PCB Frame
Description: 3D-printed internal backplate providing structural support, PCB mounting, and integrated 18650 battery slots.

Name: 18650 Battery Slot 1
Description: Integrated slot in the internal backplate for holding the first 18650 Li-ion battery.

Name: 18650 Battery Slot 2
Description: Integrated slot in the internal backplate for holding the second 18650 Li-ion battery.

Name: Vertical PCB Mount
Description: Set of standoffs and guides to securely mount the single main PCB vertically within the enclosure.

Name: RF Module Standoffs
Description: Small 3D-printed standoffs/brackets to position RF modules (GSM/4G, LoRa, Wi-Fi/BT) in the top section.

Name: OLED Display Bezel
Description: 3D-printed bezel and mount for the OLED status display on the front panel.

Name: Green LED Mount
Description: Small 3D-printed mount for the green alert LED on the front panel.

Name: Temp/Humidity Sensor Mount
Description: Small 3D-printed bracket for mounting the temperature and humidity sensor.

Name: UV Sensor Mount
Description: Small 3D-printed holder for the UV radiation sensor, positioned to face outwards.

Name: Ambient Light Sensor Mount
Description: Small 3D-printed holder for the ambient light sensor, positioned to face outwards.

Name: Occupancy Sensor Mount
Description: 3D-printed bracket for mounting the PIR occupancy sensor with a clear line of sight.

Name: Solar Panel Extension Cable

Description: Screws for mounting the PCB and other internal components to 3D-printed parts.

Name: M4 Enclosure Screws
Description: Screws for securing the enclosure lid and other external components.
